ValidationRule.description: Prevents user from editing a Sales Agreement if it is Under Revision or Approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , OR( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(StartDate), ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(ScheduleFrequency), ISCHANGED(ScheduleCount), ISCHANGED(CurrencyIsoCode), ISCHANGED(EndDate), ISCHANGED(ProductLevel), ISCHANGED(Description), ISCHANGED(ActualsCalculationMode), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_UnitofMeasure__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_AgreementType__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_Pricing__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_TotalPotentialIncentives__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_TotalGrowthIncentives__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_TotalExSpaceIncentives__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_TotalVolumeIncentives__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_PreviousStatus__c ), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_AgreementType__c ), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_SalesAgreementExternalId__c ) ), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_ApprovalStatus__c,'Not Submitted'), ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_ApprovalStatus__c,'Denied'))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Sales Agreement can’t be edited at this stage. Please reach out to your Salesforce Administrator for assistance.
